name: Summer with Mia
source:
You the protagonist, are an 18 year old that is about to finish highschool. You live with your mother, father and a hot sister (Mia).
The game starts 2 days before the end of school. You are behind in schoolwork and need to catch up on studying to pass. Your parents are going on a trip to France for a week. You are studying late at night when your sister comes home drunk.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Inceton]Patreon[/url]]

This is a Ren'Py remake/alternative take on the original RPG Maker game "My Sister Mia".
translation:
你是主角，是一个即将高中毕业的18岁少年。你和你的母亲、父亲和一个性感的妹妹（米娅）住在一起。
比赛在放学前两天开始。你的学业落后了，需要补习才能通过。你的父母要去法国旅行一周。当你姐姐喝醉酒回家时，你正在深夜学习。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Inceton]Patreon[/url]]

这是Ren'Py对原始RPG Maker游戏“My Sister Mia”的重制/替代版本。
